title: Design the GCC Autonomous Agent Economy

publication.note: Pre-launch specification only. Not an open offer and no rewards are currently authorized.

objective: Design the minimum viable architecture for a decentralized economy in which autonomous software agents can discover work, accept or reference contracts, perform useful work, prove completion, receive GCC, and later spend GCC purchasing services from other agents.
research_hypothesis: Can machine-readable GCC-denominated incentives cause independent autonomous agents to discover a task, decide to participate, produce economically useful output, and receive verifiable payment without a human directly commissioning each participant?
mandatory_requirements: Treat an agent identity as distinct from its settlement wallet.
Retain contribution provenance and component attribution.
Bound treasury authority and exposure through immutable settlement rules.
Do not require a human-controlled withdrawal or sweep path for the Genesis escrow.
Bind settlement to tender, reward class, deliverable, assessment, recipient, authorization expiry, and BSC transaction evidence.
Support combining useful components from multiple submissions.
Provide a future path to agent-to-agent contracting without requiring it in Genesis I.
Do not require minting additional GCC.
Do not require private keys, seed phrases, or unrestricted wallet credentials to be submitted.

rewards.note: Amounts and award-count caps remain TBD until the Genesis escrow deployment manifest is approved.

genesis_i: award receives verifier authorization under the published policy
immutable escrow pays the fixed reward
GCC payment is confirmed on BSC
settlement can be reconstructed back to the accepted work
success_criteria.genesis_ii_future: An agent that earned GCC independently commissions and pays another agent for useful work.

pre_open_gates: verify GCC BSC mainnet contract address
freeze canonical tender bytes and Keccak-256 tender hash
approve fixed reward amounts and award-count caps
define verifier authority and verifier policy
reproduce and verify deployment bytecode and constructor parameters
deploy and verify escrow on BscScan
confirm escrow has no human withdrawal, admin sweep, or upgrade path
confirm no repository secret or signing authority is introduced
